title: LocalAI/commands.json
description: Your own slash commands for the message box. A command expands into a prompt the user sees in the box and sends by hand; it cannot set a system prompt. A tool command asks the assistant to use a tool the user already has, and the tool keeps its own approval step. A name is lowercase, unique and not a built-in command.

commands.description: The commands, in the order the slash menu lists them.

name.description: What the user types after the slash: lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Not a built-in command (see x-reserved-names).

description.description: One line shown in the slash menu.

type.description: prompt expands a template into the message box; tool asks the assistant to use a tool.

template.description: For a prompt command: the text that goes in the message box. Write an argument as {{name}}; each one must be listed in args.

args.description: For a prompt command: the named arguments of the template, filled in order from what the user types after the name. A missing one takes its default.

default.description: The value used when the user types none. A string has at most 200 characters.

tool.description: For a tool command: the name of a tool the user already has.
